generation_method: built-in premium image generation followed by centered aspect crop, downsampling and metadata stripping to exact 1200x630 sRGB PNG
review_method: Each generated draft and each exact final PNG was visually inspected separately, then all six were compared as a set for white-background textbook quality, story fidelity, readable labels, safe margins, clipping and compositional differentiation. This is assistant editorial QA, not external human review.
criteria: six to twelve meaningful story-specific components
no clipping, overlap, distortion or invented claims
no photorealism, people, robots, devices, physical scenes or stock-photo composition

rejected_attempts.reason: Rejected first draft because it used generic robot figures, violating the diagram-only policy.
Rejected first draft because dark/transparent regions and paragraph-scale text weakened white-background dominance and mobile legibility.

Rejected an unused provenance concept because the illustration depended on cameras and display devices, violating the physical-object prohibition; the final selected story and map diagram replaced it.
